sources.snippet: Qwen 3.5 is the "native multimodal agent" generation of the Qwen family: it's built to see, read, code, browse, and plan like an all‑in‑one AI worker rather than "just" a chat model.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: The Qwen3.5 27B native vision-language Dense model incorporates a linear attention mechanism, delivering fast response times while balancing inference speed and performance. Its overall capabilities are comparable to those of the Qwen3.5-122B-A10B.

sources.snippet: For the base model baselines, we compare the Qwen3 series base models with the Qwen2.5 base models (Yang et al., 2024b) and other leading open-source base models, including DeepSeek-V3 Base (Liu et al., 2024a), Gemma-3 (Team et al., 2025), Llama-3 (Dubey et al., 2024), and Llama-4 (Meta-AI, 2025) series base models, in terms of scale of parameters.
